deep.reconstruction:
This page holds no mathematical derivation. It is a heavily corrected pencil draft of a letter, almost certainly to the editor of Crelle's Journal (C. W. Borchardt), about the publication of Riemann's 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen' (Crelle 54, 1857). It continues the draft on the previous page, which was headed 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen von B. Riemann'. The page reuses a printed shipping or inventory form ('No. der Karte', 'Zeichen', 'Stück', 'Pfund', 'Loth').

Content, paraphrased and reconstructed (uncertain readings in brackets):

1. The editor had suggested adding examples to the second piece, the preliminary topological part on surfaces (published as the analysis-situs propositions on simply and multiply connected surfaces). Riemann replies that he had also considered this. He had intended to insert examples right after the words 'Veranlassung zu einer Unterscheidung der Flächen in einfach zusammenhängende und mehrfach zusammenhängende [...]'. A cancelled interlinear note reads roughly 'wie ich [...] bei der mündlichen Mittheilung'.

2. He did not want to lengthen the paper further, since its whole content lies only in one theorem ('da [ihr] ganzer Inhalt nur in dem Satze [...]'). He therefore limited himself to the two examples that could be given without figures.

3. On an enclosed slip ('anliegendes Blättchen') he has drawn the simplest cases of simply, doubly and triply connected surfaces. He asks whether giving these examples will seem sufficient.

4. Illustrating the later, more general propositions on connectivity would, because of the great variety of possible cases, distract from grasping the essentials rather than ease it.

5. He then begins to propose a wording correction to one proposition. The phrase 'der mit den beiden ersten Flächentheilen längs a [zusammenhängt]' is to be put in place of a bracketed part. This refers to a statement about surface pieces joined along a cut or line a. The final draft fragment 'Der Satz' breaks off.

Mathematical substance (my own gloss, not on the page): Riemann's connectivity order N of a bounded surface equals 1 + (the maximal number of cross-cuts that leave it connected), which is N = 2 - chi. A disc has N = 1, an annulus N = 2, a disc with two holes N = 3. These are presumably the 'einfachsten Fälle' on the enclosed slip.

results.what: Classification of surfaces into simply, doubly and triply connected, illustrated by simple examples (presumably disc, annulus, disc with two holes), and the editorial decision to give only the two examples that need no figures.
results.modern_name: Riemann's order of connectivity (Zusammenhangszahl); for bounded surfaces N = 2 - chi = 1 + rank H_1

deep.surprise_reason: This is editorial correspondence about adding examples to the published 1857 analysis-situs section. It contains no new mathematics. It is of minor biographical interest for the editorial history of the paper, including the mention of an enclosed sketch slip and of an earlier oral communication.

checkable.asserts: Connectivity order N = 2 - Euler characteristic gives 1, 2, 3 for disc (chi=1), annulus (chi=0) and disc with two holes (chi=-1), i.e. simply, doubly and triply connected.

checkable.sympy: all(2 - (2 - 2*g - b) == 2*g + b for g in range(4) for b in range(1, 5))
checkable.asserts: For a compact orientable surface of genus g with b > 0 boundary components, N = 2 - chi = 2g + b, the Riemann connectivity order.

transcription_corrections: Line 1: probably 'Die von Ihnen vorgeschlagene Hinzufügung einiger Beispiele in dem zweiten Aufsatze hatte auch ich', not 'in der ganzen'.
Line 3: 'Unterscheidung der Flächen in einfach zusammenhängende und [mehrfach zusammenhängende]' — the quoted phrase is from the published text, and 'gegenwärtig/folgende' is uncertain.
Line 5: 'verwandeln' (cancelled) is the end of the quoted passage, followed by 'einzuschalten'. The interlinear note reads roughly 'wie ich ... bei der mündlichen Mittheilung'.
'da sie ohnehin [?] ... in dem Drucke' should probably read 'da ihr ganzer Inhalt nur in dem Satze [...]', matching the parallel sentence on the previous page.

'einfachsten Fälle, ... zweifach, dreifach zusammenhängender Flächen verzeichnet' — a marginal addition (right margin, roughly 'Gegend/Fläche') belongs here. The right-margin '(765' looks like a later archival/library number, not Riemann's.
'späteren allgemeinen Sätze über den Zusammenhang der Flächen würde[n] ... nur ... die Auffassung des Wesentlichen mehr ablenken als sie erleichtern' — 'über die Zusammenhang' is a misreading.
